verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official, documented remote MCP server at https://mcp.ramp.com/mcp. The docs cover admin role- and user-based access controls, a demo endpoint, and multi-business aliases, and the support article names compatible clients such as Claude and ChatGPT. Ramp also publishes companion Developer and Data MCP servers. A live probe independently confirms an OAuth-gated MCP endpoint that conforms to the MCP authorization spec and enumerates granular read/write scopes. The documented gap that bill approvals are not yet available via MCP is minor relative to the story of connecting an agent.
